d: Assistant Manager – Cloud and Infrastructure | PureCS
At PureCS, the technology arm of PureHealth Group, we are advancing our vision of democratizing longevity through technology, data, and AI.

We are looking for an experienced Assistant Manager – Cloud and Infrastructure to manage and optimize our enterprise messaging, identity, virtualization, and Windows Server infrastructure across on premises and cloud environments.
q: 7–10 years of relevant professional experience in cloud, infrastructure, and enterprise IT administration.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Information Security, or a related discipline.
Strong hands on expertise in Microsoft Exchange, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID.
Practical experience with VMware vSphere and Windows Server administration.
Experience implementing Microsoft Purview Information Protection and DLP policies.
PowerShell scripting and automation skills, along with infrastructure monitoring and reporting experience.
Familiarity with ITIL processes, change control, and security best practices.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Relevant certifications in Microsoft 365, Identity and Access Management, Security and Compliance, VMware, Exchange, or ITIL will be an advantage.
r: li
Manage Microsoft Exchange Server (on premises/SE) and Exchange Online, including hybrid environments, migrations, and troubleshooting.
li

li
Manage Microsoft 365 services, including tenant administration, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive for Business.
li

li

x: At PureCS, you will contribute to a technology environment focused on enabling innovation across healthcare.
